subject: Intro request: credibility call with AllSpark Therapeutics (pilot use case)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@allsparktx.com>, Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@allsparktx.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jun 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Intro request: credibility call with AllSpark Therapeutics (pilot use case)

Emma / Carlos —

Thanks again for the productive discovery last week. As we talked about on the demo, the AllSpark team has a late-stage pilot requirement around clinician-facing inference with strict PII handling and on-prem deployment constraints. To help close internal risk and procurement questions quickly, would you be open to a 30-minute "credibility call" with a peer customer who has run a similar pilot and is comfortable speaking about compliance, rollout lessons learned, and measured latency/cost outcomes?

High-level ask: one 30-min call (recording optional) covering architecture, integration time, and any surprise tradeoffs. Ideal peer: late-stage therapeutic / medtech, deployed in hybrid (VPC + on-prem) with SOC2 + HIPAA posture.

I'm attaching the RFP fragment so you have context (AllSpark_RFP_Q3.pdf). If that's helpful, Marissa on our advocacy team can coordinate the intro and a brief pre-call agenda. Ben from Solutions will join to answer any technical questions during the call.

Proposed times (PDT): Thu 6/15 10:00–10:30, Thu 6/15 15:00–15:30, or Tue 6/20 09:00–09:30.

Would either of those windows work?

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0167

Attachments: AllSpark_RFP_Q3.pdf (11 pages)

From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@allsparktx.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jun 2028 11:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Intro request: credibility call with AllSpark Therapeutics (pilot use case)

Jordan —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the RFP snippet. Yes, a peer call would be exactly what our legal and clinical ops teams are asking for. Two things to flag from our side: 1) we need a reference that can speak specifically to on-prem KMS integration and 2) we'd prefer a peer that ran a pilot targeting clinician workflows (not just batch inference).

The windows on 6/15 look tight for our execs; Tue 6/20 09:00 PDT looks best. Can you confirm a speaker who can address KMS/HSM and data residency? Also — procurement may ask for a short, redacted one-pager about the pilot outcomes ahead of the call.

Thanks,
Emma Liu
Head of Strategic Programs | AllSpark Therapeutics
emma.liu@allsparktx.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@allsparktx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jun 2028 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro request: credibility call with AllSpark Therapeutics (pilot use case)

Emma — thanks for the details. Looping in Marissa (Advocacy) and Ben (Solutions) to coordinate a precise match.

Marissa — can you propose one or two customer advocates who satisfy: late-stage therapeutic/medtech, ran a clinician-facing pilot, and can speak to on-prem KMS/HSM integration? Prefer someone who can share a one-page redacted outcomes summary before the call.

Ben — can you confirm you'll be available on Tue 6/20 09:00 PDT to cover the technical Q&A on KMS, network peering, and quantization/tradeoffs? I want to keep the call tight (30 mins).

Suggested mutual action plan for the week:
- Wed 6/14–6/15: Marissa to propose advocate + attach redacted 1-pager (pilot-scope-v1.docx)
- Thu 6/16: All parties confirm attendee list + agenda
- Tue 6/20 09:00 PDT: 30-min call (recording optional)

Thanks —
Jordan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Emma Liu <emma.liu@allsparktx.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jun 2028 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro request: credibility call with AllSpark Therapeutics (pilot use case)

Hi Emma / Jordan —

We have a good candidate: Rafael Silva, CTO at HelixBio, who led a hybrid deployment pilot earlier this year. HelixBio's pilot included HSM-backed key rotation, a private control plane in their VPC, and a short on-prem inference node for PHI-processing. Rafael has been a very straightforward reference about tradeoffs (quantization impact on latency, rolling back models, and procurement timelines).

Rafael is willing to do a 30-min call and can provide a redacted one-pager summarizing latency and cost delta vs. their prior approach. I attached a draft of the one-pager for your intake (pilot-scope-v1.docx).

Proposed confirmed time: Tue 20 Jun 2028 09:00 PDT — Rafael confirmed availability. Please let me know the attendee list (names + titles) from AllSpark so Rafael can prepare.

Call agenda (30 min):
1) 5m quick intros + pilot context
2) 10m Rafael covers architecture & KMS/HSM integration decisions
3) 10m Q&A (procurement + solutions)
4) 5m next steps and any follow-ups

Rafael's contact: Rafael Silva <rafael.silva@helixbio.com>. Rafael — please let me know if you prefer a quick pre-call sync with our Solutions lead (Ben) on Monday.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Advocacy Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0246

Attachments: pilot-scope-v1.docx (1 page, redacted)

From: Rafael Silva <rafael.silva@helixbio.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Emma Liu <emma.liu@allsparktx.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro request: credibility call with AllSpark Therapeutics (pilot use case)

Hi all —

Happy to do the call on Tue 20 Jun 2028 at 09:00 PDT. Quick notes from HelixBio's side:
- We can share a redacted one-pager ahead of time (see Marissa's attachment).
- Ben, a short pre-call sync on Monday (15–20 minutes) would help ensure we focus the Q&A on KMS/HSM sequencing and peering.
- We usually ask that external vendors provide a short non-disclosure confirmation for recorded calls; if AllSpark needs that, we can accept a simple mutual NDA.

Looking forward to it —
Rafael Silva
CTO | HelixBio
rafael.silva@helixbio.com | +1 (617) 555-0920
